newsitem.title: UK: Colombia's mark Eurobond due Thursday - traders.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's mark Eurobond due Thursday - traders.

text.p: Colombia will launch a mark- denominated Eurobond on Thursday following investor presentations in late September, syndicate officials close to the deal said on Tuesday.
Joint lead managers for the transaction are Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Merrill Lynch.
They said the floating-rate note would likely be for 275 million marks and mature after five years.
Price talk is around 145 basis points over three-month LIBOR, a syndicate official in Frankfurt said.
The FRN will be listed on the Luxembourg stock exchange.

In November last year, Colombia launched its debut mark-denominated Eurobond -- a 150 million mark five-year fixed-rate offering to yield 200 b.p. over the 9.0 percent Bund due October 2000. It paid a 7.25 percent coupon.
In October this year, Standard & Poor's Corp affirmed its triple-B minus foreign currency rating on Colombia and for the country's upcoming mark-denominated Eurobond.
Moody's Investors Service rates Colombia Baa3.
